name: Foil Ticket
description: A ticket that tilts deeply toward the pointer and casts a long shadow away from it, with a foil strip that shifts colour as it turns.

props.name: rotateDepth
props.description: Largest tilt on each axis, in degrees.

props.name: translateDepth
props.description: How far the card travels toward the pointer, in pixels. The shadow moves the other way, further.

props.name: foil
props.description: Draws the foil strip across the card, with a notch cut into each edge beside it. Place it with the custom properties --miyuki-foil-ticket-foil-y (top, default 66.667%) and --miyuki-foil-ticket-foil-h (height, default 1.75rem) and leave that band of your content empty.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer element, which sets the card's size, for example w-75 aspect-[5/7].

props.name: children
props.description: The face of the ticket. A focusable element inside tilts the card on keyboard focus and shows the focus ring around it.
